_what_this_is: the maintainer decision permitting ONE Phase-C1 launcher session -- attempt 14 -- under the amended execution package. An INPUT to the issuer, which derives every identity from the committed objects and REFUSES a grant that asserts one.
_where_this_lives: inside its own run, at logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c1/runs/attempt14/governance/grant.json, because a grant is a fact about one attempt and needs an owner. Runs are grouped by the stage their experiment config DECLARES -- Phase C1 declares stage 1, projection and structural initialization. `open_run` admits this path by name as a declared prepared input, alongside the readiness record, the authorization and the bundle record; `grant_provenance_gate` then refuses unless the authorization's recorded reference resolves to THIS file and still hashes to what it recorded.
granted_for: Phase C1 fixed-path ATTENTION isolation -- Attempt 14
granted_by: the maintainer decision of 2026-09-11 approving the execution package, AS AMENDED the same day after attempt 11, and the maintainer direction of 2026-09-12 to proceed to an actual launch rather than add another round of engineering preparation. The amendment withdrew, prospectively, both the three-session cap and the one-provider-resource-per-invocation rule. Attempt 12 was a $0.0000 provider capacity refusal -- the create was declined, no resource existed, nothing billed -- which the package explicitly treats as handled by backing off and requesting a host at a better moment, with no repository change required. Money, science, price and the one-billing-resource invariant are unchanged. Terms: configs/experiments/phase_c1/authorization.json:execution_package. Attempt 12's closeout: logs/runs/phase_c1/attempt12/closeout/outcome.json. AND the maintainer direction of 2026-09-13, after attempt 13 aborted at $0 inside `open_run`: the occupancy contract was repaired so that the four artifacts the pre-launch sequence writes into a run may pre-exist, attempt 13 was closed as CONSUMED, and a fresh one-use chain was directed for attempt 14 under the SAME already-approved execution package. No new budget, science or protocol decision was taken.
covers: exactly one C1 launch under the UNCHANGED frozen C1 protocol at a hard ceiling of $15.1475: the frozen fixed-path ATTENTION isolation, 2 frozen arms x 3 frozen fresh paired seeds = exactly six E1_KD_HEAVY_0860K recovery trainings; ALL SIX trainings complete before any confirmation evaluation begins; exactly one frozen confirmation evaluation per completed probe, each admitted against its own observed generation protocol before scoring; followed by the existing frozen GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE decision rule. Nothing in the protocol, the arms, the seeds, the battery, the recovery recipe, the generation protocol, the scoring contract, the statistic or the behavioural vetoes may move.

one_use.what_that_means: this authorization funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three draws, all sharing this session's single $15.1475 ceiling. It may never have two resources billing at once: SessionRunner.release_and_confirm requires the PROVIDER to report an abandoned pod not billing before the next is created, and aborts the session if that cannot be confirmed.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization. Unchanged -- what the 2026-09-11 amendment withdrew is the cap on how many such sessions may exist, not the rule that each authorization funds exactly one.
one_use.after_consumption: this grant is spent. A further session needs a NEW grant, a NEW launch-bound readiness record, a NEW one-use authorization and a NEW bundle.

package.amended: 2026-09-11, withdrawing the session cap and the one-resource rule, prospectively
package.limits_do_not_transfer: the engineering allowance, the per-session ceiling, the package total and the project cap bind separately. Money now bounds how many sessions are possible; there is no separate count.
package.acquisition: up to 3 host draws in this session, one billing resource at a time, each abandoned draw released with provider confirmation and recorded with its own pod id, cost and watchdog. create_attempts stays 1: draws replace an unusable host, they do not chase stock.
package.stop_and_report: formal probe training started; whether it started cannot be confirmed; a real replay mismatch; a frozen-science conflict; unverifiable evidence provenance; or any complete valid GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE, all three of which end this round.
package._sessions_note: attempts 10, 11 and 12. Attempt 12 cost $0.0000 -- the provider refused the create -- so it is a session that happened and booked nothing.

pre_provider_refusal: a pre-provider gate refusal costs $0.00 and creates nothing, but under this package it still CONSUMES this attempt, because the launcher was invoked under an issued one-use authorization. That is the accepted cost of counting attempts at invocation rather than at provider creation.
does_not_authorize: a second launcher session under THIS grant
more than three host draws in this session
two billing resources at any instant
a draw taken without the provider confirming the previous one stopped billing
a second launch under THIS grant
any retry after formal probe training has started
a retry when it cannot be confirmed whether training started
re-running a valid INCONCLUSIVE in pursuit of a GO
a GPU class other than the accepted secure L40S
using the GPU engineering allowance for complete formal probes or for an endpoint measurement on the frozen confirmation battery
authorizes_nothing_by_itself: this document is an INPUT. It creates no provider resource and permits no execution on its own. A launch additionally requires a launch-bound readiness record swept on the clean pre-authorization tree, an authorization issued from this grant, an exact-session bundle that round-trips, a live quote at or below the accepted rate, and every pre-provider gate passing.

price.rate_is_checked_live: the launcher reads gpuTypes[0].securePrice before creating anything and refuses above --max-price at $0. communityPrice is a different product and has never gated this session.
price.no_fallback_pre_approved: a different GPU class is a repricing and is not authorized here.

_capacity_note: this grant does not wait on a stock LABEL. Attempt 12 was refused at a 'Low' reading, and 'Low' is not 'none' -- attempt 10 launched at 'Medium' and attempt 11 at 'Low', and neither label predicted the outcome. A null reading is UNKNOWN, not available and not permanently unavailable. What gates the launch is the live securePrice quote at or below the accepted $1.09/h and every pre-provider gate, not an inventory adjective. Repeated create calls to chase stock remain unauthorized; create_attempts stays 1. Attempt 13 adds nothing to that reading: it never reached a quote.
